component.name: Raven Viewer
component.summary: Read, write and convert PDF, Word and text files on Raven Linux

description.p: A fast, free document reader. Continuous PDF pages rendered in pure Rust, a table of contents and annotation list in the sidebar, search, zoom and dark pages; Word documents (.docx and Word 97–2003 .doc) and text files open to read or edit — headings, lists, emphasis, tables and pictures — and save as DOCX, DOC, PDF or text. New documents start from a blank page. No browser, no account, nothing to pay for.
